cat <<'SCRIPT' | sudo -n bash
set -Eeuo pipefail

echo "STEP 1: install cryptsetup"
dnf install -y cryptsetup >/tmp/dnf-cryptsetup.log 2>&1 || { tail -50 /tmp/dnf-cryptsetup.log; exit 1; }
rpm -q cryptsetup

echo "STEP 2: create backing image for encrypted volume"
install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/secure-vol
IMG=/var/lib/secure-vol/srv-secure.img
if [ ! -f "$IMG" ]; then
  truncate -s 2G "$IMG"
fi
ls -la "$IMG"

echo "STEP 3: generate LUKS keyfile"
install -d -m 0700 /etc/cryptsetup-keys.d
KEYFILE=/etc/cryptsetup-keys.d/srv-secure.key
if [ ! -f "$KEYFILE" ]; then
  ( umask 077; head -c 512 /dev/urandom > "$KEYFILE" )
fi
chmod 400 "$KEYFILE"
chown root:root "$KEYFILE"
ls -la "$KEYFILE"

echo "STEP 4: luksFormat the backing file (idempotent)"
if ! cryptsetup isLuks "$IMG" 2>/dev/null; then
  cryptsetup luksFormat --batch-mode --type luks2 "$IMG" "$KEYFILE"
fi
cryptsetup luksDump "$IMG" | head -20

echo "STEP 5: open the mapping and format filesystem if new"
MAPNAME=srv-secure
if [ ! -e /dev/mapper/$MAPNAME ]; then
  cryptsetup open --key-file "$KEYFILE" "$IMG" $MAPNAME
fi
if ! blkid /dev/mapper/$MAPNAME -o value -s TYPE >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  mkfs.xfs -L srvsecure /dev/mapper/$MAPNAME
fi
blkid /dev/mapper/$MAPNAME

echo "STEP 6: mountpoint"
mkdir -p /srv/secure

echo "STEP 7: crypttab entry (idempotent)"
CRYPTTAB_LINE="$MAPNAME $IMG $KEYFILE luks,nofail"
if ! grep -qF "$MAPNAME" /etc/crypttab 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "$CRYPTTAB_LINE" >> /etc/crypttab
fi
cat /etc/crypttab

echo "STEP 8: fstab entry (idempotent)"
FSTAB_LINE="/dev/mapper/$MAPNAME /srv/secure xfs defaults,nofail 0 2"
if ! grep -q "/srv/secure" /etc/fstab 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "$FSTAB_LINE" >> /etc/fstab
fi
grep secure /etc/fstab

echo "STEP 9: mount now if not mounted"
if ! mountpoint -q /srv/secure; then
  mount /srv/secure
fi
mountpoint /srv/secure
touch /srv/secure/marker-file-from-setup.txt
echo hello-encrypted-world > /srv/secure/marker-file-from-setup.txt

echo "STEP 10: SELinux relabel"
restorecon -R /srv/secure || true
ls -laZ /srv/secure

echo "STEP 11: reload systemd units for crypttab/fstab"
systemctl daemon-reload

echo "STEP 12: verification snapshot"
lsblk -f
df -h /srv/secure
cat /srv/secure/marker-file-from-setup.txt

echo "SETUP COMPLETE"
